title: Ensemble Golden Sentinel Runner for Quant Accuracy Audits
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a robust, automated accuracy sentinel that runs an ensemble of golden prompt suites and statistical checks against candidate quantized builds (FP8, INT8) before rollout. The runner will: 1) execute multiple curated golden sets (functional, safety, domain-critical), 2) compute both per-token and semantic metrics, 3) run hypothesis testing and bootstrap confidence intervals to detect subtle shifts, and 4) produce a single pass/fail verdict with graded warnings that integrate into CI and rollout automation. This ticket covers the pipeline orchestration, gating logic, telemetry, and initial dashboarding for release gates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end from an artifact tag and returns JSON verdict and metrics
Golden-pass-rate calculation implemented with configurable per-suite thresholds
Semantic similarity check (embedding cosine) included with configurable threshold
Logprob drift metric computed per-prompt and aggregated with median and 95% CI
Hypothesis test (paired bootstrap) flags shifts with p-value and effect size
Failure triggers block in canary channel; warnings allow limited canary with telemetry
Results written to artifacts bucket and surfaced in Console dashboard with links
Performance: full suite for baseline 7k prompts completes within scheduled CI budget (<2h)
